Faqs.Question: What is foundation footing treatment and why is it important?
Faqs.Answer: Concrete footings are naturally porous and sit directly in the soil. Footing treatment seals the cold joint where your foundation wall meets the concrete footing, stopping groundwater from wicking upward into the slab or crawl space via capillary action.

Faqs.Question: Why do I need backfill protection boards over the wall membrane?
Faqs.Answer: When heavy equipment pushes clay, crushed stone, and rocks back against your foundation walls during grading, those rocks can easily puncture fresh rubberized membranes. Backfill protection boards act as an armor shield, permanently safeguarding your waterproof seal.

ServicesPageSettings.Heading: Our Waterproofing Services
ServicesPageSettings.LeadText: Explore our comprehensive suite of foundation and site drainage services designed to shield your home from water damage.

Services.Title: Foundation Footing Treatment
Services.Description: Precision preparation, sealing, and waterproof coating of foundation footings to eliminate capillary water absorption and wicking at the base of your structure.

Services.Title: Waterproofing Wall Membrane
Services.Description: Application of high-performance elastomeric and sheet membranes on foundation walls to create an impenetrable barrier against soil moisture and hydrostatic pressure.

Services.Title: Drainage Systems (French Drains)
Services.Description: Custom-engineered perforated pipe and aggregate French drain installations that capture groundwater at the footing level and direct it safely away.

Services.Title: Backfill Protection
Services.Description: Installation of dimpled drainage boards and protective layers that safeguard freshly applied waterproof membranes from damage during soil backfilling and compaction.

ServicesPageSettings.SpotlightText: Water intrusion can cause mold, wood rot, foundation shifting, and thousands of dollars in structural damage. A properly installed waterproofing system pays for itself in peace of mind.
